python_interfaces.name: RfcHistoryRiskProvider
python_interfaces.rule: Read-only against one stable Snapshot for preview or the current caller UnitOfWork for writer revalidation. READY returns LOW|HIGH plus exact evidence count and complete SOMA_RFC_HIERARCHY_HISTORY_AUTHORITY_V1 provider_fingerprint; INDETERMINATE fails closed. LLD-03 exact-compares the bounded authority through SOMA_RFC_HIERARCHY_REVIEW_V1 and never receives Task/WFM/Objective history rows. A relevant history change invalidates an older review even if LOW/HIGH is unchanged. Other hard-delete dependencies are obtained through their separately declared providers rather than hidden behind this interface.

python_interfaces.name: RfcSourceEvidenceProvider
python_interfaces.rule: LLD-04 owns immutable published source observation/provenance and versioned source vocabulary/precedence; LLD-03 owns accepted current RFC projection and never parses raw workbook content. has_accepted_source_provenance is read-only and accepts stable snapshot or current writer read context for hard-delete preview/commit.

python_interfaces.name: SrSourceEvidenceProvider
python_interfaces.rule: validation resolves the exact immutable LLD-04 evidence identity to its published Advanced Search SR observation and proves canonical SR identity, field key, typed value/value-state and profile/vocabulary authority. LLD-03 stores that evidence identity as an opaque cross-packet reference and never creates a physical FK/trigger into LLD-04 private tables or parses raw workbook rows.

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestCustomerClassificationParticipant
python_interfaces.rule: invoked only when canonical SR Customer changes, including clearing it; incompatible current CPL classification is invalidated with history in caller UoW and no replacement is silently selected.

python_interfaces.name: RfcTerminalTaskParticipant
python_interfaces.rule: LLD-05 owns WFM/Task/Objective lifecycle and commits nothing independently. Hard-delete classify is read-only and accepts stable snapshot or current writer read context; terminal apply runs inside the LLD-03 caller UnitOfWork after revalidation/proof/receipt.

python_interfaces.name: RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant
python_interfaces.rule: LLD-09 owns Communication links/frozen summary/orphan grace and commits nothing independently. Hard-delete classify is read-only and accepts stable snapshot or current writer read context; accepted terminal evidence alone never calls apply.

python_interfaces.name: RfcInventoryDependencyProvider
python_interfaces.rule: read-only under stable snapshot or current writer read context; Inventory cannot be deleted or rewritten to manufacture RFC hard-delete eligibility.

python_interfaces.name: DeliberateActionProofProvider
python_interfaces.owner: LLD-12 authenticated-session/action-proof boundary with LLD-10 interaction contract
python_interfaces.rule: proof is server/session-bound single-use friction evidence for the governed deliberate interaction; owner business/freshness guards run first and a client-supplied boolean/timestamp is never sufficient.

python_interfaces.name: DeviceReferenceResolutionReader
python_interfaces.rule: read-only derived registration context; LLD-03 never writes Network Elements or changes relationship target identity.

ownership_rule: Every participant receives only the bounded reader/UnitOfWork contract declared here, mutates only its owner packet when apply-capable, never commits independently, and returns immutable result references or a determinate classification. The canonical callable authority remains interfaces/cross-packet-v2.json.
